item.title: Demystifying the 'this' Keyword
item.description: Ah, this in JavaScript… the single keyword that has probably produced more confusion and stack overflow threads than anything else in the entire language. :') In languages like Java or C#, this always points to the current class instance. In JavaScript? this doesn’t care where a function was declared — it only cares about how the function was called. Here is the field guide I wish someone had handed me years ago.
